report_identity: Commit containing review-round-1; report commit is distinct from the reviewed candidate and is resolved after ordinary push.

findings.title: Berry settlement commits the timestamp before, rather than after, the mechanism-specific work
findings.candidate_claim: Both affected bodies explicitly label settlement as ordered, list old watering/new drying before step 6, and put time_last_updated at that final step.
findings.independent_source_result: The common update writes time_alive, growth_stage and then time_last_updated at lines 136–140. Only afterwards does it branch into new drying (142–153) or old stage-water flag/weather lookup/watering (154–158).

minimal_static_design.premises: Valid planted old-mechanism plot, base 3 hours, stored GROWTHMULCH, first lifetime 9 hours, positive elapsed time, explicit settlement, no replant or other writes; Rain category when reaching old watering.
minimal_static_design.ordered_expected: Common duration is 8100 seconds; time_alive=32400 and stage=5 are written, then the timestamp is committed to the sampled current time, then the old stage-water flag and Rain watering are handled. The candidate instead mandates the timestamp after those branch writes.
minimal_static_design.reverse: Unplanted or elapsed time ≤0 returns before the common writes; the ordinary old display path still does not settle. A later branch failure, if explicitly supplied as an artificial fault condition, cannot make the earlier timestamp write uncommitted. This is a static control-flow checkpoint, not an executed failure/demo or a claim of default failure reachability.

findings.impact: Terminal values in successful BP18 do not reveal this incorrect sequence. The retained prose misstates the common-versus-branch commit boundary; a faithful reader could defer the timestamp, including across later failures. No runtime defect or newly introduced regression is claimed.
findings.provenance: Already present in the accepted B09 original and final §5.2; B14 retains it while changing this same settlement domain. Exact approved application is correct, but application identity cannot validate this retained body assertion.
findings.minimum_revision: In both §5.2 bodies, put the timestamp write with the common time/stage update before the mechanism-specific branch. Keep the existing mulch, watering/drying, replant and early-return results. Add or extend a bounded static ordered-write design; preserve every old catalog ID/order/multiplicity and unrelated row. The original §5.2 change is beyond the exact b37533ef patch and needs a new bounded original-synchronization authorization before application.
findings.required_recheck: Freeze a successor and compare the complete current B09→successor and candidate→successor changes; reread the two corrected §5.2 clauses and the ordered positive/reverse design against source 97–159. Repeat only affected identity/catalog checks and retain separate affected-owner gates.
